messages:
emily: Okay new inside joke alert 11 Meet Pip the Post-it, our unofficial mascot. Found a stack of Post-its with tiny faces this morning. Who started this adorable rebellion?

raj: guilty. I drew one during a long meeting and left it on the monitor. It attracted a friend and now we have a colony. :seedling:

carmen: Colony!? Are we doing a mascot vote? Pip, Poppy, or Sticky Steve? React with :one: :two: :three:?

emily: Polls open. Also we should have a tiny origin story. Raj, any lore?

raj: yes1 Backstory draft: Pip is an ex-standup sticky note who left the pad to explore desk culture. Powers: summarizing long threads into 3 words, calming paperclips.

alex: I have a sticker printer at home. If we choose a name, I can make 30 pins/stickers. Low-cost karma generator for the office.

dev-bot: Reminder: please do not affix stickers to monitors or rented equipment. Use the community board or personal laptops. :information_source:

carmen: Good point. Proposal: stickers go on the community corkboard and there will be an adoption sign-up sheet.

ops-bot: Note: office-wide labeling policy requires adhesive materials be approved for communal surfaces. Submit a ticket to facilities. :clipboard:

emily: Fine. Naming round final: :one: Pip, :two: Poppy, :three: Sticky Steve. Based on reactions, Pip leads.

raj: Also idea: monthly "Pip Patrol" where someone leaves a tiny Post-it with a compliment on a random desk. Nominate volunteers.

alex: In. I will print stickers after facilities OK. Also can do enamel pin mockups if there's enough interest.

carmen: If we get pins, I will design a cape for Pip. Tiny cape equals instant lore.

emily: Done. Action items: @alex files facilities ticket, @raj drafts Pip origin micro-story in the culture doc, @carmen sketches cape. If anyone wants to adopt a Pip, sign the digital sheet.

raj: PS: someone left a Pip that says "deploys are dragons, coffee is the sword". Legendary content. :dragon:

emily: Closing thread but maintaining eternal vigilance over our sticky mascots. Welcome, Pip the Post-it, to Redwood lore. :sparkles:
